_note: Dialogue by npc id. talk = branches (first whose 'if' passes; a branch can say/set/give/take/silver/renown); rumors = townsfolk who cycle canon rumors; script = a scripted scene in js/events.js. RULED 09-24: the seat drafts reserved persons' words for this game; drafts are logged in invented.json.

marta.name: Marta Venn

say: Pie two coppers, sausage three.
She looks at Vivian, and at you, and says nothing. She says nothing unless Viv's in real danger.
Pie two coppers, sausage three. Broth and small beer before dawn.
Fifty gold for the thing in the guano mine's deep gallery, they say at my tables.

marta.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 22; ext Silverton npcs (Marta Venn); wiki/vivian.md

gull.name: Gull

say: Two silver a laborer for the day. No names asked: add half.
The guano mine's taking cull hands. Heard it at the corner this morning.

gull.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 25; GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md (hires by voice at the day-labor corner)

say: Ladders a silver, poles five coppers. After dark, at the side gate, add half.
Half my props walk off by night. Crews I know by sight. I don't name them.

brennock.name: Brennock

say: Dead stock in, tallow and glue out.
He nods at Vivian the way you nod at a courier. Neither of them says a word about maps.
Dead stock in, tallow and glue out. The smell marks the district's edge.
Which shafts run safe, which run wet, which the night crews watch? That's a price, not a conversation.

brennock.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 27; wiki/the-warrens.md (Brennock holds the old-workings map); wiki/vivian.md

say: Secondhand at a fifth of new. I buy at a third, no questions.
Everything stolen in this town surfaces here or at the pawnbroker's.

oldhob.name: Old Hob

say: Hob Rennick. Dosed. Past the lamp-line more times than the book says.
Buy me a dose and I'll talk. Or work a shift at the cradles beside me, across the water.

oldhob.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §4 (Old Hob; sleeps in a flop-cellar in the Shaft Rows)

vivian.name: Vivian

say: The candle girl, on vice row between the booths. She never owns coin on a card night.
Ly. Warda's youngest, playing the hero. You grew up over the Hex; you don't need a candle. Buy one anyway.
The candle girl, on vice row between the booths. She never owns coin on a card night.
The farmhand off the sand. I watched you get up against Cutter. Everybody did.
The candle girl, on vice row between the booths. She never owns coin on a card night.
You're new. I saw you come through the gate.

vivian.src: wiki/vivian.md; rogue-vivian.md (via ext-party); per-lead lines seat draft 09-24 (playtest: Lymen is from here)

say: A farm boy with a hand-me-down spellbook, sleeping on the sun god's floor: the god he was running from.
Heading up to the wizard school, he says. Classes start in the fall. The Rebel Schools of the Black Mountains. You've heard the tales?

pete.name: Warrens Pete

say: Six of us went down past the wet. Six came up. Six.
He says six a little too fast, and orders another.

pete.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md (Warrens Pete tells it bigger every night; says 'six' too fast)

say: Past the wet the shaft stops being a shaft. Dressed stone. A mark on the wall. The air comes up smelling like rain.
Six came up. He drinks.
West gate. The road runs a mile to the fork. North of the fork, the Tower. South, the gulch and the long road to the Pit.
East gate's the feed track to the Warrens bridge. The north gate, up the cut behind me, is the Doors road. Nobody bothers the dwarves.
The notary's senior clerk. Plain, grey-eyed, dressed like a clerk and mistaken for one on purpose.
She reads every ledger the scriptorium copies and forgets nothing she reads. She does not stop to talk.

casper.name: Casper Venn

say: He won't touch unsealed paper. "Androit first. I value what's been sworn to, not what's been hoped."
He breaks nothing, reads everything, and writes a figure at the bottom in silver.
"Tell Winters it's a fair estate. Not a rich one."
Newland mint, old dwarven silver, wizard coin, arena chits. I change them all.
He looks at Vivian. He knows what she does on the row, and he prices it.
Newland mint, old dwarven silver, wizard coin, arena chits. I change them all.
Thirty silver all in one hand? Smaller than you think.

casper.src: wiki/fountain-street.md (Casper Venn); ext Silverton npcs; wiki/the-venns.md

say: Androit turns the first page, then the second, then sits down to read the third.
"A mender's hand. Written true, because nobody was ever meant to read it." He looks up. "Leave it with me. This is the kind of history I meant."
He reads Winters' inventory through once, slowly, and presses his seal into the wax.
"Now it's true. Casper Venn for the value."
Contracts, charters, manumissions, wills. Literacy is scarce. My seal makes things true.
Before the grave I want this town's real history written down true.
The factor's clerk. His voice is burned; it comes out a rasp.
He looks at Aurdin a long moment. You can't afford it, he said, the first time. He was right.
The wizard-nation factor's clerk, voice burned by a Doorwarden in the ash-years.
The Tower? You can't afford it.
Dusk sendings are cheaper. A noon sending is a tell.
Thirty silver at the window frees a slave. No questions asked, either way. The rates are what they are.
Three coppers the common bath. Private room, hot water carried, five silver.
She hears everything said in the steam, and passes on only the small things.
Common clothes five silver, traveler's two gold, factor-cut fine fifteen.
Silver-thread trim was the old luxury line. Now it's mostly memory.
"Not till Mical signs the Pryor crate off. I've been paid in promises before."
He counts it, then counts it again, and puts it in the forge's iron box.
"Tell Winters the forge is square."
Shoes, wheels, barrels, harness. Dwarven tools under rune-warranty go at triple.
My father died in the Water Burning. I rebuilt this forge on borrowed coin.
Shave, tooth, stitch. Fight nights I work the arena's chair.
Bleeding? Three coppers. I'll advise against it.

venhale.name: Venn Hale

say: The fighters' stables. Part gymnasium, part debtors' prison.
I can arrange a closed meeting with any fighter in the stables, for a sound reason. The card's run from Korvin's slate, inside the Hex.

venhale.src: wiki/the-hex.md (Venn Hale, the stables); ext Silverton npcs

ned.name: Ned Halloway

say: Ned looks at Aurdin's spellbook the way a man looks at a road he didn't finish.
"Classes start in the fall, they say. They said that to me, too."
Edmund Halloway. Ned. Wizard, second circle, halted.
"I went up the mountain road once, as far as the cut. Then I came back down and took a job labeling jars. The labels are very good."

ned.src: wiki/vice-row.md (Ned Halloway, wizard 2 up from Newland, stopped halfway up the mountain road, CANON 09-09); lines seat draft 09-24

percy.name: Percy

say: A fireball's worth of guano and sulfur, one silver the paper.
Ned Halloway, behind the counter, nods at Aurdin. Everyone calls him Ned. He scared himself out of going up to the Doors.
Percy's Particulars. A fireball's worth of guano and sulfur, one silver the paper.
Gland's half-drained. You carried it warm. I don't render what renders me.

percy.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 38; ext Silverton npcs (Percy quotes; Ned Halloway)

say: Five coppers the common pipe. The couch and the good leaf, five silver.
She remembers every face in the smoke room, and what each came to forget. You are not going in.

aldwin.name: Aldwin

say: Bread at six. At quarter past, for the proud.
The old priest looks at Aurdin and says nothing about the sun god. Fifty years at the bread line teaches a man when not to.
Bread at six. At quarter past, for the proud.
The floor's free, if the old man likes your face.

aldwin.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 30; wiki/fountain-street.md (Aldwin, fifty years at the bread line)

say: A penny a night, dreams included. Some of them not yours.
Don't sleep with your fist open.
She checks the Pryor manifest against the crate twice. It matches, which seems to surprise her.
She signs it off her books. "Brennan's next, I suppose. Winters settles his dead in order."
Warehouses, no quay. The river's too small and fast to carry anything.
Seventeen years of manifests. She knows exactly which ones don't match what arrives.
A big farm-handed man at the end of the bench with ten silver in his fist. The crowd chalked him BARLEY.
Barley Pete Johnson. No relation.
Warda's youngest, in chain mail from the show-armorer, a hand-carved green token at his throat.
Silverton's outside Newland's writ. I took the oath anyway. Kalindel.
The champion, plains barbarian, sitting easy on the edge of the sand. He talks to horses, they say.
He looks you over the way he looks over a horse. Take it up with Korvin at the slate.

bartenderS.name: Bartender

say: Ale's four coppers the mug. A gallon's two silver, the bench's way.
Behind the southeast bar: the Wall of Boxes. Twenty-seven of them.

bartenderS.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 17; wiki/the-hex.md (the Wall of Boxes)

gambler1.name: Gambler

say: The high-roller room is behind a door you can't open. When the Weigh-House lamp is lit, the council sits here.

gambler1.src: wiki/silverton.md (council venue: the Hex's second floor, RULED 08-25d)

say: Jory Slade, the crew boss. Ex-collar. He milked his way out on the deep rate.
Neither cruel nor kind. He decides, shift by shift, whose name gets written short.
He walks the cradles with a pole and a count. Stay out of the way of the poles.
They're not locked. They're promised.
He talks sideways about what the deep margin sounded like the week the rate went to three.
An old dosed hand by the kitchen. Work a shift at the cradles and he'll talk you through the settle.

hobB.name: Old Hob

say: Past the lamp-line the mine stops being Thrane's. Where the lamps stop, the mine stops.
The daytime way down is at the top of the drift. Take the bucket at the deep station. Don't ask me why. Just take it.

hobB.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the lamp-line; the bucket at the deep station)

say: The night crews' lateral. The low point drops to the pools.
They're not locked, they're promised.
Seventeen, Edric's niece, her first morning. Sent up the feed track because thin soil will not feed her.
Three good thimbles and she's a Pellam with coin. Six bad and she's a line in the book.

crew1.name: Crew hand

say: The worked face. Six hands and a boss to a station. Don't stand behind a sledge.

crew1.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md (Sheet B: each gallery's east end a worked face with a crew station)

say: A silver the thimble up here. Three below the wet. Nobody I know goes past the wet for the three.
The mine-head kitchen feeds dose-paid crews morning and dusk. No coin touches that food.

bunkhouse.name: Bunkhouse

say: The resident core sleeps here. Rows of bunks, lamp-tallow smell, a man snoring through the day.

bunkhouse.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (housing: a resident core at the mouth camp)

say: A small office. Three spears in a rack, a pole for the cradles. On a nail, a lantern-token.
The Pellam barns at the south landing bunk the day-crews, for rent paid in thimbles.
I came down at twenty-three, the crisis winter. Never went back up.
He tells you what the Furnace was like before the mountain closed, and gets the year wrong.

dace.name: Corwen Dace

say: You went down. You came back up. He wants to know everything about it.
Corwen Dace, the house's ambitious grandson. A late-blooming wizard with a year-old spellbook.
The deep gallery has no roost. A torch is lawful down there. And bright light is the thing's weakness. The hands won't tell you that. They've never been.

dace.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §8 (Dace tells them; bright light is the cloaker's weakness)

say: The mark on the wall, the last lamp, the shaft head. Past here the ladder's last pitch goes down to the deep gallery.
Nobody goes down past the mark. Ottilie's word. Bring light if you go anyway.
The drive ground. When the rattle goes, the bats come this way. Spears up, mouths shut.
The family's own door. The Pollards, the Skerrows and Corwen Dace. Nobody answers.

weighshed.name: The weigh-shed

say: The house weighs its own sacks here. The buying is done in town, at Rillo's shed by the clean warehouse.

weighshed.src: wiki/fountain-street.md (Rillo buys at his shed in town, CANON 09-20c)

scrapeboss.name: Scrape boss

say: Hooded lamps only, and not on the floor. Look up if you don't believe me. Quietly.

scrapeboss.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §2 G2 (no lamps on the floor, hooded lamps carried only)

scraper1.name: Scraper

say: Eight coppers a day on the scrape, fed at the mouth morning and dusk. Honest coin. No dose, no deductions.

scraper1.src: wiki/guano-galleries.md (wages; contrast with the east side)

say: Two crews, one cave. They settle it here, rope and no blades.
We cut at noon, when the spiders sulk. The boy drums so nothing surprises anyone.
The far end? The ettercap turned up two seasons back. Our price doubled. We won't guide you there.
Tum. Tum. Tum. He doesn't stop drumming to talk to you.
A big man gone quiet in the middle. He runs the yard. The well's for drinking. Nobody draws from the lake.

gennetGrief.name: The inn lady

say: The inn lady sits at the table with her apron balled in her hands. She doesn't look up.
"It gave back," she says, to nobody. "It always gave back."

gennetGrief.src: RULED 09-24 (Griz: post-credits, the wife is inconsolable); wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (the lake gives back)

adoptedKid.name: A small girl

say: A small girl skipping stones in the shallows, never out past the knee-deep water.
The inn lady says she's for the kitchen.

adoptedKid.src: RULED 09-24 (an extra kid playing out back)

elsbethCandles.name: Elsbeth

say: Elsbeth, on vice row with a tray of candles and a lamp on a pole.
"Candles? I sell them to everyone." She nearly smiles. "I was told that's what you say."

elsbethCandles.src: RULED 09-24 (Griz: post-credits, the dishes girl is the new candle girl in Silverton); wiki/vivian.md (candles to 'everyone')

doranIn.name: Doran Waterby

say: He fills a mug and sets it down in front of you and doesn't meet your eye.
The inn's been in the family since the wedding. The lake's older. It named the place.

doranIn.src: module-halfway-inn.md §4; wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (the lake pre-dates the inn and named it)

say: A boy of fourteen, keeping the stone stack at the point straight. He does it every day.
An eleven-year-old skimming stones, never out past the knee-deep water.

gennet.name: The inn lady

say: The inn lady keeps the common room, and the lantern on its hook by the lake door.
The lake gives back, she says. It always gives back.

gennet.src: wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (Gennet: the theology is hers; 'It gives back'); spec §4 (stub the sprite as the inn lady)

katarina.name: A traveler

say: A young woman in a farm woman's brown dress, writing in a thick bound book by the fire. She covers the page when you look.

katarina.src: wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (a mender writing a book at the inn is the campaign-start secret)
